infill_flat_roof_minimal.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

bungalow_postwar_ranch.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

toronto_foursquare_red_brick.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

detached_infill_rammed_earth.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

med_villa_tuscan.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

clapboard_north_end.assumption: One detached home, with no secondary suite assumed. Contextual permitted routes require a separate site assessment.

infill_duplex.assumption: Two side-by-side homes. Calgary classifies this arrangement as semi-detached, rather than a stacked duplex.

montreal_duplex_plateau.assumption: Two stacked homes, treated as a Duplex Dwelling.

nordic_timber_mass_timber.assumption: Residential apartments; no shops or offices assumed.

courtyard_family_brick_modern.assumption: Residential entrance building; the shared courtyard is designed separately.
courtyard_family_brick_modern.review: Confirm the number and arrangement of homes and whether all required access is within this building.

rndsqr_midrise_terraced_garden.assumption: Terraced apartments with a described live-work frontage.
rndsqr_midrise_terraced_garden.review: Confirm whether the live-work frontage adds an Office or another commercial use.

cast_iron_italianate.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

beltline_brick_modern.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

vancouverism_classic.assumption: Teaching program: apartments above or alongside retail. Both residential and retail uses must be listed; changing the shop program changes the result.

parisian_corner_cafe_culture.assumption: Apartments over an unlicensed café. A licensed restaurant would need its own use check.

glass_tower_blue_reflective.assumption: Office tower, including its entrance lobby; no residential use assumed.

art_deco_cream_terracotta.assumption: The architectural form does not determine its occupancy.
art_deco_cream_terracotta.review: Catalogue sources conflict between office and residential use. Choose and verify the occupied program before matching.

art_deco_streamline_moderne.assumption: The architectural form does not determine its occupancy.
art_deco_streamline_moderne.review: Catalogue sources conflict between office and residential use. Choose and verify the occupied program before matching.

mass_timber_biophilic_barn.assumption: Library reading, collection and associated spaces.

deco_theater_movie_palace.assumption: Cinema/movie theatre, with associated lobby spaces.

biophilic_mass_timber_pool.assumption: Indoor swimming facility. A community-operated facility may follow a different use definition.

mediterranean_resort_courtyard.assumption: Hotel guest accommodation with associated reception and pool.

timber_sanctuary_church_glazed_gable.assumption: Place of worship; the small/medium/large designation depends on assembly area.
timber_sanctuary_church_glazed_gable.review: Assembly area has not been recorded. Confirm the worship size class and how the spire is measured for height.

gothic_community_church_single_spire.assumption: Place of worship; the small/medium/large designation depends on assembly area.
gothic_community_church_single_spire.review: Assembly area has not been recorded. Confirm the worship size class and how the spire is measured for height.

reference_charcoal_gable_fourplex_v1.review: Four entrances do not establish a legal Rowhouse Building. Confirm stacking, party walls and unit access before choosing the bylaw use.

minimalist_infill_brick_monolith.review: Confirm whether this exact model contains one dwelling or multiple attached dwellings, and their access arrangement.

contemporary_townhouse_timber_screen.review: Confirm whether this exact model contains one dwelling or multiple attached dwellings, and their access arrangement.

brewery_crystal_brewhouse.review: Confirm the intended production program and whether a public taproom or restaurant adds another use.

machiya_cafe_gallery.review: Confirm whether the gallery is a museum, retail art gallery or artist’s studio; each uses different bylaw definitions.

rec_centre_timber_hall.review: Confirm the operator and activity program before selecting Community Recreation Facility or Indoor Recreation Facility.

market_historic_iron_glass.review: Confirm the vendor mix, food preparation and shared areas; market architecture alone does not determine all required uses.

station_victorian_iron_glass.assumption: Passenger station with platforms, ticketing and café.
station_victorian_iron_glass.review: Transportation infrastructure and accessory café uses require a dedicated site and operator review.

biophilic_mass_timber_campus.assumption: Art and design education with studios and gallery.
biophilic_mass_timber_campus.review: Confirm the education provider, student level and public gallery program before choosing the school use.
